name: Server Console
summary: A dashboard for your Automaton server: CPU, memory, disk, OS updates, restart status, versions, certificates and backups, with 24 hours of history and email and webhook warnings.
description: Shows how your Automaton server and its Runners are doing: CPU, memory, disk and load with 24 hours of history, Docker disk use, OS name and uptime, pending and security updates, restart required, server and Runner versions and whether a newer release exists, certificate expiry and the last backup. Sends one warning, by email through the server's SMTP and by webhook, when disk space runs low, security updates wait too long or a restart is overdue, and one message when it is resolved. It asks for server:read and notify:email. With server:cleanup approved it also shows the nightly cleanup (last run, space freed, next run, a warning if it failed) read-only, with a link to change it in Studio. With runner:maintain approved for a Runner by an administrator, a system administrator can run the Docker cleanup now, read an app's recent logs, restart an app and read Docker's disk use on that one machine; nothing else is changed on the server.

application.description: A dashboard for your Automaton server: CPU, memory, disk, OS updates, restart status, versions, certificates and backups, with 24 hours of history and email and webhook warnings.

arguments: python -m py_compile main.py console.py && mkdir -p dist/ui && cp main.py console.py index.html dashboard.js console.css dist/ && cp ui/app.css ui/app.js dist/ui/

settings.name: API_BASE_URL
settings.description: Optional. Base URL of this Automaton server's API; normally the server provides it, so leave empty

settings.name: STUDIO_URL
settings.description: Optional. Address of Studio for the Change in Studio link on the Cleanup card; normally worked out from the page or the API address, so leave empty

settings.name: EMAIL_TO
settings.description: Who gets warning emails through the server's SMTP: administrators, owner, project or off

settings.name: DISK_FREE_WARN_PERCENT
settings.description: Warn when less than this percent of the disk is free

settings.name: SECURITY_UPDATE_DAYS
settings.description: Warn when security updates have been waiting longer than this many days

settings.name: REBOOT_DAYS
settings.description: Warn when a restart has been required longer than this many days

secrets.name: WEBHOOK_URL
secrets.description: Where warnings are sent: a Slack, Discord or Telegram webhook URL, or any URL that accepts a JSON POST. Optional, in addition to the email. Empty: no webhook
